Exclude selectors work in plain text output mode

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<body><div class=\"nav\">Navigation</div><p>Article body</p></body>", "{\"exclude_selectors\":[\".nav\"],\"output_format\":\"Plain\"}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
